text:
sam_pm: Heads-up from today's ACME call: they want a microtiered pricing addon that guarantees per-route throughput for marketing endpoints, plus two launch exemptions per year. They asked for a 30-day pilot and a predictable invoice.

marie_sales: They prefer a clean addon they can buy self-serve. Main asks: guaranteed QPS per route, short provisioning (<72h), and explicit surge carveouts for product launches.

lee_eng: Implementation options:
- soft QoS tokens on shared pools (fast to ship, cheaper, weaker isolation)
- route-level reservation (logical reservations, medium effort)
- pinned dedicated pools (strong isolation, KV warmup penalty, costly).
We need expected traffic patterns (burst size, baseline) to recommend.

carlos_ops: automation note: current automated pool spinup is ~72h. We can aim for 48h but requires ~2 sprints of infra work (onboarding API + capacity orchestration).

priya_fin: Pricing framing suggestions:
1) Microtier addon: $5k/mo per high-priority route (includes 250k tokens), $0.02/token overage. Predictable and simple.
2) Bundled tier: Enterprise Plus includes up to 10 priority routes at $30k/mo. More sales friction.
3) Pilot special: 30-day trial at 50% discount for the first route to validate usage.
Preferred for forecasting: option 1.

legal_bot: Draft clause suggestion:
- Exemptions limited to 2 launch events per 12 months.
- Each exemption up to 96 hours with 72h notification preferred; emergency launches allowed but subject to double overage rate if no notice.
- Provider may route to fallback model/variant after continuous 96h surge; customer will be notified.

sam_pm: launch criteria proposal for pilot:
- Telemetry: per-route p95 latency < 200ms, error rate <0.5%
- Billing: invoice preview agreed and billing export enabled
- Legal: pilot SLA + exemption language signed
- Ops: 72h provisioning guarantee for pilot (we commit to 72h, roadmap 48h post-GA)

marie_sales: customer will accept 72h for pilot. They want the billing to be invoice-line item named "Priority Route - <route>".

lee_eng: For pilot low-risk path: implement soft QoS tokens + per-route telemetry dashboard. That avoids KV warmup and should be deliverable in ~1 dev-week + 0.5 SRE-week. If pilot shows sustained launches that exceed soft limits, propose conversion to route-level reservations or dedicated pools.

carlos_ops: Confirming effort estimate and noting we need feature flags for rollout and fallback policies documented. Also need a canary plan for routing policy changes.

priya_fin: For pilot pricing doc: I'll prepare a two-column sheet (Microtier vs Bundle) and include trial template and revenue forecasts for ARR impact.

legal_bot: I'll produce sample contract language for the exemption clause and a short pilot addendum. Key points: notification windows, maximum exemptions, emergency surcharge, fallback description.

sam_pm: Decision (proposed): ship a Microtier Priority-Route addon as a pilot using soft QoS tokens + telemetry, 30-day discounted trial, 72h provisioning commitment. Track whether sustained surges trigger conversion to reserved pools.

marie_sales: Approved by sales. We'll present the addon config and pricing to ACME tomorrow.

lee_eng: I'll scope the telemetry dashboard and soft-QoS implementation, expect a PR within 5 working days.

carlos_ops: We'll add provisioning automation to the infra backlog; estimate 2 sprints to reach 48h target.

priya_fin: I'll circulate the pricing sheet and trial terms by EOD.

legal_bot: Draft clause ETA: EOD tomorrow.

sam_pm: Action items:
- sam_pm: send ACME onboarding & data request (7-day traffic trace) by EOD today
- marie_sales: demo addon config to ACME and confirm acceptance of 72h pilot provisioning
- lee_eng: deliver soft-QoS prototype + telemetry spec in 5 days
- carlos_ops: provide infra ETA for 48h automation next week
- priya_fin: pricing sheet + trial template by EOD
- legal_bot: pilot addendum draft by EOD tomorrow

marie_sales: pinging ACME now, will update thread when they confirm. :rocket:
